record: Phase E: new semantic roles validated by a three-judge adjudication

panel.note: anthropic--claude-4.5-sonnet was replaced: it appended content after its JSON on every batch and produced no usable judgment
panel.transport: local LiteLLM proxy, outside every repository

candidates.selection: train/calibration and sealed fields whose property name carries the concept word

adjudication.rule: at least two of three identical

distance.note: hierarchy depth fields (DistanceFromRoot) excluded; they were the only misses

rating.note: numeric columns only; 7 panel-rating fields are strings and are not routed

product_model.reason: the correct hits are dominated by CAP test-fixture entities (BasicLifecycle, CancelOnCreate, ...); in real business entities (ModelCosts, ModelUsages) "model" meant a costing model

whyNotRetrained: the candidates sit almost entirely in the train and sealed partitions (4 in calibration); the release gate floors routing at 5 correct calibration decisions per role, so a retrained head would keep every new role auxiliary. The roles are routed by validated name rules instead; the head is re-qualified with frozen weights only to carry the new registry fingerprint.
sealedLabelsUnchanged: sealed rows keep their original labels; release gates count classifier decisions only, and the new roles are not head labels
